description: ÖV-Güte auf Gemeindeebene is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Der Datensatz "ÖV-Güte auf Gemeindeebene" liefert eine gemeindescharfe Bewertung der Erreichbarkeit des öffentlichen Verkehrs in Deutschland auf Basis des Klassifikationssystems der ÖV-Güteklassen. Der Indikator der ÖV-Güteklassen wurde im mFUND-Vorhaben GOAT 3.0 entwickelt und der Datensatz in diesem Kontext für ganz Deutschland berechnet. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are daseinsvorsorge, erreichbarkeit, erschließung, hvd, öv-güte. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/BIN. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
